Reasonable hull This rate is 3.5% includes insurance against the risks "hijacking", "total loss" within the indexed sum insured for 1 year; risk insurance "harm" applies only to cases of accidents occurring with the participation of well-known 2 or more persons on the driver's fault, authorized by the management according to the Insurance Contract, to differentiate payout depending on the model, but not more than 45 000 rubles (nonaggregate, 1 case in year).
